control_requirements.requirement: Use result-space-only lighting actuation; source position, size, count and fill remain uncertain physical hypotheses.
Keep Color/Tone value/chroma/hue and shadow-floor/highlight response separately owned from Light/Form coverage, contrast, gradient and sheen.
Create a face-plane versus neck-shadow pair, a shoulder plane, and a lower-shirt tone scope; broad lighting prose cannot erase these local relationships.
No global white-balance correction is justified by the illustrated gray clothing; preserve regional color relationships.
